notablePrerequisites:
Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Archfiend of the Dross to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.
